_comment: Manual logo URLs that beat everything fetch-logos.mjs works out on its own. Grouped by kind and keyed by the id from src/data/teams.ts, leagues.ts or cups.ts. Use it for anything the scraper gets wrong or cannot find — public/logos/_report.json lists the misses after a run, and the wrong-picture cases only show up by looking at the files.

teams._comment: en.wikipedia has no article for either club, so the search falls through to something else entirely: Pato Branco to the NBB league page, Platense to Independiente's Wikidata item.
